creator: Claude
name: Small Dead Pine
source_format: MagicaVoxel VOX v150 (SIZE, XYZI, RGBA), single model

derived.glb_note: Derived from the .vox by tools/claude/export_glb.py; do not edit by hand. Linear COLOR_0 vertex colours, one material.

resolution_rationale: The same metric design was voxelised at 0.20, 0.10 and 0.05 m and compared. At 0.20 m (165 voxels) every branch is as thick as the trunk and the tree becomes a blobby column with no pine branching. At 0.05 m the silhouette is finer but turns into many single-cell twigs that the brief warns against and that would shimmer at distance. 0.10 m is the coarsest tier that keeps whorled pine branching, the broken ends and the snapped leader readable (trunk 2 cells, limbs 1 cell).
godot_mapping: godot = ((vx - px) * s, (vz - pz) * s, -(vy - py) * s)
pivot_note: Trunk base centre at ground level (not the bounding-box centre; the crown leans toward +X).
front_note: Vegetation has no functional front; the drooping dead limb and the stripped windward face are arranged toward the default camera (-X / +Y).
dimensions_note: Occupied extents of the voxel grid (X width, Y depth, Z height).
palette: Shared Claude pilot palette (tools/claude/voxkit.py); one material family per 8-swatch row in MagicaVoxel's palette grid.
collision_hint: Capsule r=0.12 m, h=4.4 m at the pivot (trunk only); branches non-colliding.
story: A young pine that died standing at the edge of a clearing: leaning away from the wind, leader snapped and replaced by a crooked branch, the windward side stripped, a few rust-brown tufts clinging on the lee side.
notes: Prevailing wind modelled from -X: the lee (+X) side carries the longest limbs.
Roots spread on the ground plane (z = 0); no soil mound, so it sits on any terrain.
